topic: GPU GDSC status-register derivation (HOST-VERIFIED, no device read performed)
purpose: Until round 55 the four constants in drivers/NativeAdreno/AdrenoDomainState.h (CX status 0x05091540, GX status 0x05091010, CX on-bit 31, GX on/off-bits 16/15) were ASSERTED in a comment. This pins the three Linux v6.12 sources that DERIVE them, so the derivation becomes mechanically checkable instead of asserted (m13019, m12247).

upstream_rule.title: the GDSC status register and its masks are a FUNCTION of the descriptor, not a constant
upstream_rule.order: reg  = POLL_CFG_GDSCR ? gdscr + 0x4 : (gds_hw_ctrl ? gds_hw_ctrl : gdscr); masks = POLL_CFG_GDSCR ? {up=BIT(16), down=BIT(15)} : {on=PWR_ON_MASK BIT(31), off=!BIT(31)}

round57_sequence_derivation.why: Round 56 derived the STATUS register and its masks. Round 57 derives the ENABLE/DISABLE step sequence, so what AdrenoPowerUpV1 step 0 means for CX is read out of gdsc_enable()/gdsc_disable() instead of being asserted.
round57_sequence_derivation.enable_order: PWRSTS_ON -> deassert_reset; SW_RESET -> assert+delay+deassert; CLAMP_IO -> (AON_RESET -> assert_reset_aon) + deassert_clamp_io; toggle_logic(ON); PWRSTS_OFF -> force_mem_on; delay 1; HW_CTRL -> hwctrl(on)+delay 1; RETAIN_FF_ENABLE -> retain_ff_on
round57_sequence_derivation.disable_order: PWRSTS_ON -> assert_reset; HW_CTRL -> hwctrl(off)+delay 1+poll(ON); PWRSTS_OFF -> clear_mem_on; PWRSTS_RET_ON -> return; toggle_logic(OFF, synced_poweroff); CLAMP_IO -> assert_clamp_io
round57_sequence_derivation.votable_short_cut: gdsc.c:153-161 -- (flags & VOTABLE) && status == GDSC_OFF && !wait performs udelay(TIMEOUT_US 500) and returns 0 WITHOUT polling. This is the upstream counterpart of the DTB's qcom,no-status-check-on-disable on gpu_cx_gdsc.
round57_sequence_derivation.gx_cpu_plan_why: gpu_gx_gdsc.pd.power_on == gdsc_gx_do_nothing_enable AND the descriptor has no .supply and no .cxcs, so the CPU's GX enable path performs ZERO register writes. This is a PROVABLE zero, and it is why the device word 0x00088400 sits permanently down-complete.

device_measurement_reused.note: REUSED, not re-measured in round 56. Explains the permanent gx_off=1: GX .power_on = gdsc_gx_do_nothing_enable, so the CPU never powers GX on and GX is the GMU's job.

module.honest_boundary: Pure derivation from pinned sources + board DTB. NO MMIO, NO IOKit, NO firmware, NO kernel caller, NO device run, NO flash. gpu area STAYS host-verified; CONFIG_XNU_NATIVE_ADRENO remains n.

round58_composition.purpose: Tie the round-57 derived GDSC step plans to the round-51 ordered power-up plan, so 'the CPU cannot act on this domain' is a derived fact rather than a comment.

invariant.statement: For every genpd step of the power-up plan, StepGuarded(step) == (the CPU's GDSC register writes for that domain == 0).

derivation.cx: gdsc.c:150 clears the collapse bit at 0x106c (ONE write); the 0x1540 status is then READ by gdsc_poll_status, not written
derivation.gx: gpu_gx_gdsc.pd.power_on is gdsc_gx_do_nothing_enable() and the descriptor has neither .supply nor .cxcs, so nothing is left

disable_asymmetry.hazard: VOTABLE short-cut (gdsc.c:153-161, mirrored by the board DTB qcom,no-status-check-on-disable): a successful CX power-off has NO status confirmation. Never infer 'CX is quiet' from a zero return; round 53 showed a read of the powered-down kgsl SMMU may bus-abort.

corrections_this_round.actual: 1 write (the collapse clear); the status poll is a read
corrections_this_round.fix: constant and comment corrected to 1 in both the module and the test

corrections_this_round.actual: the OFF poll lives in gdsc_toggle_logic (gdsc.c:177); gdsc_disable only polls for ON after dropping HW_CTRL
corrections_this_round.fix: cross verifier now asserts the toggle_logic poll plus the gdsc_disable ON poll separately

round58_composition.honest_boundary: Derivation from sha256-pinned Linux v6.12 sources plus the vendored board DTB. No MMIO, no domain powered, no firmware loaded, no CI run, no device run. gpu area stays host-verified; CONFIG_XNU_NATIVE_ADRENO stays n.
